checks.summary: OPTIONS answered with an Allow header listing every method.
Responses did not distinguish known from unknown users.
The approved scope has no TLS target on this address.
Overload tests are not in the approved test classes.
The Server header discloses the product and version.

findings.title: Server header discloses product and version
findings.summary: Every response carries a Server header naming the product and its exact version.

evidence.detail: Server header present on 1 of 1 responses

findings.remediation: Remove or genericize the Server header on the signaling edge.

findings.title: OPTIONS discloses the full method set
findings.summary: The Allow header lists methods the service does not need to expose to unauthenticated peers.
findings.remediation: Limit the Allow header to the methods offered to unauthenticated peers.

findings.title: INVITE accepted without authentication
findings.summary: An INVITE without credentials reached the dial plan.
findings.remediation: Challenge every INVITE from untrusted sources before routing.
